seo.title: Free Client Food Diary for Dietitians and Trainers | Caltrac AI
seo.description: Free for dietitians, nutritionists and trainers: see the meals your clients choose to share, from photo or text logs, and comment on them.
seo.h1: Review your clients' meals, from their own photo or text logs

hero.intro: Caltrac AI for Professionals is a free way for dietitians, nutritionists and trainers to see the meals their clients choose to share, and comment on them. Clients log with a photo or a short description, and stay in control of what you see.

heroImage.alt: The Caltrac AI mascot holding a phone and a bowl of salad, in front of the Caltrac AI app's calorie and macro screen

items.title: See the meals your clients log.
Comment on the meal itself.
items.text: Your client reads your comment in the Caltrac AI app, next to the food.

items.title: Give clients your linking code.
items.text: After approval you get a code. Clients enter it themselves in Caltrac Connect, from the button in the app's top bar, and send you a request. Access starts when you accept it.

items.title: Keep clients in control.
items.text: Access starts when a client grants it and ends the moment they stop sharing.

items.title: Dietitians
items.text: follow what clients ate between appointments.

items.title: Nutritionists
items.text: start reviews from the food, not from data entry.

items.title: Trainers
items.text: see what clients eat between sessions.

loggingScreenshot.alt: A meal logged from a photo in the Caltrac AI app, showing the foods found before saving

loggingText: Your client logs a meal with a photo or a short description. Caltrac AI estimates the calories and macros (protein, carbs and fat), and the client can edit the foods and serving sizes before saving. These are estimates, not exact measurements, so use them as a starting point for conversation.

items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: Joining and using Caltrac AI for Professionals is free.

items.question: How long does review take?
items.answer: A person at Caltrac AI reads every application. The review is manual, and you receive the outcome by email within 24–48 hours.

items.question: Can a client stop sharing?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. They don't need approval from you or from Caltrac AI, and it takes effect immediately.
